title: Real Cepstrum
text: Compute real cepstrum of input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Inherit FFT length from input port dimensions} sets the match the FFT length to the dimensions of the input and {FFT length}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Inherit FFT length from input port dimensions
params.values: Match the FFT length to the dimensions of the input port on (default) | off
